correctness.rationale: For reflected Brownian motion in the intrinsic coordinate with generator ∂², the normalized time is S1 S2+S2²/2. It strictly increases in S1 and S2, so strict Jensen at each fixed interval mean proves the global reduction and the equality condition. The reduced derivative is ab(bt³−at−b)/t³; the cubic decreases once then increases from negative values to infinity and its sole positive root is above 1. Substitution gives a=(t³−1)/(t³+t−1). In the corrected proof the residual ratio R satisfies R′<0 by the displayed factorization (the quartic factor is positive) while a′>0. The added exact identity for 1−R factors its numerator as (t−1)³(2t⁴+2t³+3t²+t+1), so 1−R~9(t−1)³ and a~3(t−1). At infinity, R~2/t and b~t^−2. Smooth approximations preserve the infimum by budget normalization and convergence of intrinsic lengths, with no attained smooth optimizer.
